vivian: quick sketch: proposing a small 'rank-weight lattice' that scores candidate bitpaths (fp8/int8/4bit) and returns a ranked list + risk tag. want quick sanity checks.
alejandro: what signals?
vivian: minimal: degradation_score (0-1), kv_hit (bool), token_zone (head|mid|tail), recent_confidence. output: ranked_paths + risk_tag.
sam: can you show a scoring example?
vivian: sure — prototype formula:
```
score(path) = w1*(1 - degradation_score) + w2*(kv_hit ? 1 : 0) + w3*(token_zone == tail ? 1 : 0) - penalty_if_not_supported
```
rank by score desc, filter by model_adapter.supported_paths first.
ops-bot: ops: keep cardinality low. use short hashed row ids, sample full-context <= 0.5%.
telemetry-bot: telemetry keys: rl.rule_hash, rl.inputs=(ds,kv,zone), rl.top_paths, rl.risk_bucket, rl.sampled_trace_id when captured.
alejandro: runtime compatibility: if intersection empty -> fallback_kind = "higher_fidelity_variant" or route to non-quant path. tag decision with fallback_kind.
vivian: rollout: shadow for 7-14 days @ 2-5% traffic; paired evaluation vs current heuristic per-cohort. auto-disable cohort if exact-match drop > 0.4% abs or hallucination proxy up > 0.2% abs.
sam: API ask: GET /v1/bitpath-decision?inputs=... -> {rule_hash, ranked_paths, score, explain_tag}. useful for dev replay.
vivian: i'll draft RFC: grammar, scoring weights, telemetry, runtime contract, rollout matrix, ops circuit-breakers. tagging @alejandro @sam :sparkles:
